formulas.title: Laws of Exponents
formulas.description: Used for simplifying powers where the base is the same.

formulas.title: Rationalization Identity
formulas.description: Useful for removing surds from denominators.

formulas.title: Square Root Form
formulas.formula: \sqrt{ab}=\sqrt a\sqrt b,\quad \sqrt{\frac a b}=\frac{\sqrt a}{\sqrt b}
formulas.description: Valid for non-negative values of a and positive b.

formulas.title: Decimal Expansion Rule
formulas.description: After reducing p/q, check the prime factors of the denominator.

formulas.title: Remainder Theorem
formulas.description: Substitute x = a to find the remainder directly.

formulas.title: Factor Theorem
formulas.description: A quick test for checking whether a linear factor divides a polynomial.

formulas.title: Algebraic Identity 1
formulas.description: Used in expansion and factorisation problems.

formulas.title: Algebraic Identity 2
formulas.description: A standard identity for squares of binomials.

formulas.title: Algebraic Identity 3
formulas.description: Difference of squares, often used in factorisation.

formulas.title: Cube Identity
formulas.description: Compact form for expanding a sum of cubes.

formulas.title: Sum of Cubes
formulas.description: Important for factorisation of cubic expressions.

formulas.title: Difference of Cubes
formulas.description: Used when a cubic expression appears as a difference.

formulas.title: Distance From Origin

formulas.title: Quadrant Sign Rule

formulas.title: Point on Y-axis
formulas.description: Every point on the y-axis has x-coordinate 0.

formulas.title: General Form
formulas.description: The standard form of a linear equation in two variables.

formulas.description: Here a and b are the x-intercept and y-intercept.

formulas.title: Slope-Intercept Form
formulas.description: m is the slope and c is the y-intercept.

formulas.title: Angle Sum Property
formulas.description: The sum of interior angles of a triangle is always 180 degrees.

formulas.title: Exterior Angle Property
formulas.formula: \text{Exterior angle}=\text{sum of two opposite interior angles}
formulas.description: Used in angle chasing problems.

formulas.title: Pythagoras Theorem
formulas.description: For a right triangle, hypotenuse squared equals the sum of squares of the other sides.

formulas.title: Congruence Rules
formulas.description: Standard tests for proving two triangles congruent.

formulas.title: Angle Sum
formulas.description: The sum of all interior angles of a quadrilateral.

formulas.title: Parallelogram Area
formulas.description: Applies to parallelograms and rectangles.

formulas.title: Rhombus Area
formulas.description: Area using the two diagonals of a rhombus.

formulas.title: Trapezium Area

formulas.title: Semi-Perimeter

formulas.title: Heron's Formula

formulas.title: Equilateral Triangle Area
formulas.description: Area when all sides of the triangle are equal.
